backup.stopServiceFirst: Stop the NoteFast service before running it
backup.title: Database backup
backup.helpTip: Manually generate SQLite snapshots to a local folder or S3 (rebuildable vector indexes excluded). Restoring requires running a CLI command while the service is stopped — the Web UI offers no one-click restore to prevent accidental overwrites.
backup.optLocalfsDesc: Write snapshots to a local folder — works standalone on desktop clients
backup.optConnectionDesc: Upload snapshots to S3 object storage
backup.localDirDesc: Absolute path; snapshots go to dir/prefix/snapshots/
backup.retentionDaysDesc: After each backup run, snapshots older than this are deleted automatically
backup.prefixDesc: Snapshots and media are stored under this prefix
backup.restoreHint1: Stop the service before restoring. You can dry-run with

locationSelect.empty: No connections yet — create one in the “Storage connections” panel

sync.title: Markdown archive
sync.helpTip: Exports documents together with their referenced images as Markdown copies (.md + media/), for migration and portable reading. Manual only — frontmatter carries tags and the internal ID (tags / notefast_id). Files go under the first tag as a folder, or untagged/ if none.
sync.optLocalfsDesc: Export to a local folder on the server
sync.optConnectionDesc: S3 / WebDAV, decided by connection type
sync.manualOnly: Archiving is manual only (use “Archive now” or the API); it never pushes automatically.
sync.requireDir: Please enter an absolute path for the local export directory
sync.replaceAdapter: Note: enabling will replace the current {{adapter}} adapter.
sync.exportHint: Self-contained zip (.md + media/), no storage config needed to download or re-import

syncProtocol.deviceRemoved: Device removed from the sync registry (if it keeps syncing, rotate its storage credentials to truly block it)
syncProtocol.title: Multi-device sync
syncProtocol.helpTip: Shares one storage with your clients: local changes push automatically, remote changes merge on a schedule (LWW by updated time). Reuses “Storage connection” with its own prefix.
syncProtocol.prefixDesc: Sync data is stored under this prefix
syncProtocol.hint: The first pull does a full restore from an S3 snapshot; afterwards it's an incremental merge. This feature is mainly for client multi-device sync; the Web UI can serve as a manual reconciliation entry.
syncProtocol.removeTitle: Remove (display-only; rotate S3 credentials to truly block a device)
syncProtocol.deviceHint: Device registrations live in the shared storage (one record per device). “Remove” only deletes the record — a device holding S3 credentials still needs its credentials rotated to be truly blocked.

mcp.title: MCP Access
mcp.helpTip: Let external AI assistants (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline…) read and write your knowledge base over MCP
mcp.configHintOpencode: Paste into the mcp section of opencode.json (or global ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json)
mcp.configHintClaude: Paste into the MCP config of Claude Desktop / Cursor
mcp.tokenDesc: MCP authenticates with a Bearer token. Generate a dedicated token and the config fills in automatically.
mcp.tokenOnce: This token is shown only once and cannot be viewed again; revoke it anytime in the API Tokens panel
mcp.manageHint: Existing tokens are managed in the API Tokens panel

apiTokens.scopeRequired: Please select at least one permission
apiTokens.title: API Token
apiTokens.description: Create independent tokens for external tools, MCP clients or scripts, with read/write scope split and independent revocation.
apiTokens.saveNow: Copy and store it somewhere safe now. You won't be able to view the full token again after closing this notice.
apiTokens.empty: No authorized tokens yet. Click “New token” to create the first one.

authEvents.title: Sign-in activity
authEvents.helpTip: Password is configured at deployment (AUTH_PASSWORD env) and can't be changed in-app; this only records password sign-ins. Check deployment config if you see unfamiliar records.
authEvents.emptyHint: Desktop client / API-token connections don't go through password sign-in, so this may stay empty. The password is configured at deployment (AUTH_PASSWORD), not in-app.

storageLoc.deleted: Connection deleted (capabilities referencing it now show as unconfigured)
storageLoc.title: Storage connections
storageLoc.helpTip: Configure S3-compatible / WebDAV connections once here; backup, multi-device sync and Markdown archive each pick a connection plus their own prefix.
storageLoc.empty: No storage connections yet. Create one to use it for backup / multi-device sync / Markdown archive.
storageLoc.name: Name
storageLoc.namePlaceholder: e.g. My object storage / Synology NAS
storageLoc.pathStyleHint: required for S3-compatible services; off by default for AWS
